c1:
DD India (YouTube) published a video on July 14, 2025, stating that India made history on August 23, 2023, when Chandrayaan-3 successfully achieved a soft landing near the Moon's south pole, making it the first country to do so. [1] NASA states that Chandrayaan-3 is an Indian Space Research Organization mission that landed near the south pole of the Moon on August 23, 2023. [2] Space.com reported on August 22, 2023, that the Indian Space Research Organisation successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander near the lunar south pole, marking its first moon landing and the first probe ever to land at the Moon's south pole. [3] Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, that India could become the first nation to land a spacecraft on the Moon's south pole. [4]

c2:
BBC News (YouTube) reported on August 23, 2023, that the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down as planned at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT). [5] NDTV reported on August 23, 2023, that the Vikram lander touched down at 6:04 PM on Wednesday, August 23, and ISRO celebrated the occasion with a post on X at the exact time of touchdown. [6] Space.com reported on August 22, 2023, that Chandrayaan-3 was expected to touch down at 8:34 a.m. EDT (1:34 p.m. GMT, or 6:04 p.m. in India). [3] Al Jazeera also reported on August 23, 2023, that Chandrayaan-3 was scheduled to touch down shortly after 6 PM India time (12:30 GMT). [4]
